title: Squared distance
statement: Define a struct Point with integer x and y. Read two points (x1 y1 x2 y2) and print the squared distance between them: (x2-x1)^2 + (y2-y1)^2.

title: Oldest student
statement: The first line is n. Then n lines each hold a name (no spaces, at most 20 characters) and an age. Store them in an array of structs and print the name of the oldest student; on a tie print the first one.
